clips.send: Kinetic energy. Energy of motion. KE equals ½ times m times v squared (half times mass times speed squared). Speed counts the most: twice the speed, FOUR times the KE. The cart has the most KE at the lowest point of the track, where it is fastest.
clips.text: Kinetic energy. Energy of motion. KE = ½ × m × v² (half × mass × speed squared).. Speed counts the most: twice the speed → FOUR times the KE.. The cart has the most KE at the lowest point of the track, where it is fastest.

clips.send: Conservation of energy. The total never changes. Mechanical energy equals KE + PE. Law of conservation of energy: energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transformed from one form to another. On this coaster: KE + GPE + elastic PE + thermal energy equals the energy the lift motor put in.
clips.text: Conservation of energy. The total never changes. Mechanical energy = KE + PE.. Law of conservation of energy: energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transformed from one form to another.. On this coaster: KE + GPE + elastic PE + thermal energy = the energy the lift motor put in.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Potential energy is not “no energy”. It is real energy that is stored and ready to be released.
clips.text: Common mix-up: Potential energy is not “no energy”. It is real energy that is stored and ready to be released.

clips.send: Gravitational potential energy. Energy stored by height. GPE equals m times g times h (mass times 9.8 N/kg times height). Units: joules (J). Twice the height, twice the GPE. Twice the mass, twice the GPE. The cart has the most GPE at the top of the start hill, where it is moving slowest.
clips.text: Gravitational potential energy. Energy stored by height. GPE = m × g × h (mass × 9.8 N/kg × height). Units: joules (J).. Twice the height → twice the GPE. Twice the mass → twice the GPE.. The cart has the most GPE at the top of the start hill, where it is moving slowest.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Friction does not destroy energy. It transforms mechanical energy into thermal energy that spreads out and is hard to use again.
clips.text: Common mix-up: Friction does not destroy energy. It transforms mechanical energy into thermal energy that spreads out and is hard to use again.

clips.send: Friction, thermal energy. Where “lost” energy really goes. Friction between the wheels and rails, plus air resistance, turns some mechanical energy into thermal energy (and a little sound). The rails and wheels warm up very slightly. Turn on Friction: the cart can no longer climb back to its starting height, but the Total bar stays full.
clips.text: Friction → thermal energy. Where “lost” energy really goes. Friction between the wheels and rails, plus air resistance, turns some mechanical energy into thermal energy (and a little sound).. The rails and wheels warm up very slightly.. Turn on Friction: the cart can no longer climb back to its starting height, but the Total bar stays full.

clips.send: Reference level (h equals 0). Where we measure height from. Gravitational PE is measured from a chosen reference level. Here it is the ground. At the ground, h equals 0, so GPE equals 0 J. You may choose any reference level, but you must use the same one for the whole problem.
clips.text: Reference level (h = 0). Where we measure height from. Gravitational PE is measured from a chosen reference level. Here it is the ground.. At the ground, h = 0, so GPE = 0 J.. You may choose any reference level, but you must use the same one for the whole problem.

clips.send: Common mix-up: A heavier cart does NOT go faster down the hill (without friction). It reaches the same speed, but it has more KE because it has more mass.
clips.text: Common mix-up: A heavier cart does NOT go faster down the hill (without friction). It reaches the same speed, but it has more KE because it has more mass.

clips.send: Elastic potential energy. Energy stored in a squashed spring. When the cart hits the spring bumper, its KE is stored in the compressed spring. The more the spring is compressed (or stretched), the more elastic PE it stores. The spring then pushes back, turning elastic PE into KE again — the cart rolls backwards.
clips.text: Elastic potential energy. Energy stored in a squashed spring. When the cart hits the spring bumper, its KE is stored in the compressed spring.. The more the spring is compressed (or stretched), the more elastic PE it stores.. The spring then pushes back, turning elastic PE into KE again — the cart rolls backwards.

clips.send: Lift hill and motor. Puts energy INTO the ride. An electric motor pulls the cart up the first hill with a chain. The motor does work on the cart. Work moves energy into a system: electrical energy, gravitational potential energy. After the top there is no engine. Every hill, loop and drop runs on the energy stored at the start.
clips.text: Lift hill & motor. Puts energy INTO the ride. An electric motor pulls the cart up the first hill with a chain. The motor does work on the cart.. Work moves energy into a system: electrical energy → gravitational potential energy.. After the top there is no engine. Every hill, loop and drop runs on the energy stored at the start.

clips.send: 重力势能。由于高度而储存的能量。重力势能 等于 m 乘 g 乘 h（质量 乘 9.8 N/kg 乘 高度），单位是焦耳，J。高度变为 2 倍，重力势能变为 2 倍；质量变为 2 倍，重力势能也变为 2 倍。小车在起点山顶时重力势能最大，这时它的速度最慢。
clips.text: 重力势能. 由于高度而储存的能量. 重力势能 = m × g × h（质量 × 9.8 N/kg × 高度），单位是焦耳（J）。. 高度变为 2 倍，重力势能变为 2 倍；质量变为 2 倍，重力势能也变为 2 倍。. 小车在起点山顶时重力势能最大，这时它的速度最慢。

clips.send: 摩擦，热能。“损失”的能量到底去了哪里。车轮与轨道之间的摩擦以及空气阻力，会把一部分机械能转化成热能（还有一点声能）。轨道和车轮会稍微变热。打开“摩擦力”：小车再也回不到起点的高度，但“总能量”条依然是满的。
clips.text: 摩擦 → 热能. “损失”的能量到底去了哪里. 车轮与轨道之间的摩擦以及空气阻力，会把一部分机械能转化成热能（还有一点声能）。. 轨道和车轮会稍微变热。. 打开“摩擦力”：小车再也回不到起点的高度，但“总能量”条依然是满的。

clips.send: 动能。物体由于运动而具有的能量。动能 等于 ½ 乘 m 乘 v 的平方 （二分之一 乘 质量 乘 速度的平方）。速度的影响最大：速度变为 2 倍，动能变为 4 倍！小车在轨道最低点时速度最快，动能最大。
clips.text: 动能. 物体由于运动而具有的能量. 动能 = ½ × m × v²（二分之一 × 质量 × 速度的平方）。. 速度的影响最大：速度变为 2 倍，动能变为 4 倍！. 小车在轨道最低点时速度最快，动能最大。

clips.send: 参考面（h 等于 0）。测量高度的起点。重力势能要从选定的参考面开始计算，这里我们选地面。在地面上 h 等于 0，所以重力势能为 0 J。参考面可以任意选，但同一个问题中必须始终用同一个参考面。
clips.text: 参考面（h = 0）. 测量高度的起点. 重力势能要从选定的参考面开始计算，这里我们选地面。. 在地面上 h = 0，所以重力势能为 0 J。. 参考面可以任意选，但同一个问题中必须始终用同一个参考面。

clips.send: 能量守恒。总能量保持不变。机械能 等于 动能 + 势能。能量守恒定律：能量既不会凭空产生，也不会凭空消失，它只会从一种形式转化为另一种形式。在这辆过山车上：动能 + 重力势能 + 弹性势能 + 热能 等于 电动机输入的能量。
clips.text: 能量守恒. 总能量保持不变. 机械能 = 动能 + 势能。. 能量守恒定律：能量既不会凭空产生，也不会凭空消失，它只会从一种形式转化为另一种形式。. 在这辆过山车上：动能 + 重力势能 + 弹性势能 + 热能 = 电动机输入的能量。

clips.send: 容易混淆：在没有摩擦时，更重的小车下坡并不会更快。它们的速度相同，但重的小车质量大，所以动能更大。
clips.text: 容易混淆：在没有摩擦时，更重的小车下坡并不会更快。它们的速度相同，但重的小车质量大，所以动能更大。

clips.send: 容易混淆：势能不是“没有能量”，而是真实存在、随时可以释放的储存能量。
clips.text: 容易混淆：势能不是“没有能量”，而是真实存在、随时可以释放的储存能量。

clips.send: 提升坡与电动机。把能量输入过山车。电动机通过链条把小车拉上第一座山丘，电动机对小车做了功。做功可以把能量输入系统：电能，重力势能。过了最高点就再也没有发动机了，后面所有的上坡和下坡都靠起点储存的能量。
clips.text: 提升坡与电动机. 把能量输入过山车. 电动机通过链条把小车拉上第一座山丘，电动机对小车做了功。. 做功可以把能量输入系统：电能 → 重力势能。. 过了最高点就再也没有发动机了，后面所有的上坡和下坡都靠起点储存的能量。

clips.send: 弹性势能。被压缩的弹簧储存的能量。小车撞上弹簧缓冲器时，它的动能储存到被压缩的弹簧里。弹簧被压缩（或拉伸）得越多，储存的弹性势能就越多。弹簧随后把小车推回去，弹性势能又转化成动能，小车向后运动。
clips.text: 弹性势能. 被压缩的弹簧储存的能量. 小车撞上弹簧缓冲器时，它的动能储存到被压缩的弹簧里。. 弹簧被压缩（或拉伸）得越多，储存的弹性势能就越多。. 弹簧随后把小车推回去，弹性势能又转化成动能，小车向后运动。

clips.send: 容易混淆：摩擦并没有消灭能量，而是把机械能转化成了热能，这些热能散失到周围，很难再被利用。
clips.text: 容易混淆：摩擦并没有消灭能量，而是把机械能转化成了热能，这些热能散失到周围，很难再被利用。
